product.olivetti-m300-01.summary: The entry-level M300 network workstation with Ethernet and Token Ring options.
product.olivetti-m300-01.history: The September 1991 professional catalogue presented the M300-01 as an entry-level network workstation. It offered Ethernet or Token Ring and made the hard disk optional.
product.olivetti-m300-01.architecture: Network cards could boot the system remotely. The guide lists NCU 9142 with RPL 3C503 1.5 and NCU 9172 with TRR 9209 1.03.
product.olivetti-m300-01.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.08.
product.olivetti-m300-01.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m300-01.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m300-01.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 20-1.
